gates.title: toolchain-sanity

gates.title: module-build
gates.notes: No deviation: whole-project assemble+test minus lint. Gradle units execute only when DSH_ALLOW_GRADLE=1 (see run-gates.sh header); otherwise the harness classifies the gate BLOCKED so an unbuilt tree never reads as PASS.

gates.title: contract-drift
gates.notes: Recorder at tools/contract/record.mjs is owned by another engineer; when the file is absent the harness reports BLOCKED (prerequisite missing). Exit-code map: 0=PASS, 3=BLOCKED (DSH_REMOTE_HOME unset / fixture missing per D18), other=FAIL.

gates.title: contract-replay
gates.notes: DEVIATION: ACCEPTANCE names :core:protocol:testDebugUnitTest, but :core:protocol applies the kotlin.jvm plugin (pure JVM) and has no debug variant. Correct task is :core:protocol:test. Reconcile the doc. The gate runs both replay suites: the protocol DTO decoder and the network-level recordings against contract/gateway/v0 (GatewayV0ContractReplayTest, GatewayV0FullContractReplayTest).

gates.title: pending-state-machine

gates.title: capability-matrix
gates.notes: DEVIATION: :core:domain:testDebugUnitTest -> :core:domain:test (pure JVM module).

gates.title: security-invariants
gates.notes: G09 is segmented; the harness runs every segment and combines them (any FAIL->FAIL, else any BLOCKED->BLOCKED, else PASS). Segment 3 (this shell gate) is tools/acceptance/check-source.sh. Segments 1/2/4 are gradle unit tests: G09.1 :core:domain:test (pure JVM; doc said testDebugUnitTest - DEVIATION) '*IdentityDigest*', G09.2 :core:data:testDebugUnitTest '*Redaction*' (Android module - correct), G09.4 :core:data:testDebugUnitTest '*SecretStore*'. G09.5 closes the other half of D12: G09.3(e) only forbids literals OUTSIDE SyncTuning.kt, so a field silently absent from docs/TUNING.md, or documented with a stale default, would still pass. check-tuning.sh requires the two to agree name-by-name and value-by-value (it evaluates expressions such as 8L * 1024 * 1024 rather than string-comparing), and refuses to guess on a shape it cannot parse. Negative-tested: stale value, deleted row, renamed row, unparseable default each produce exit 1.

gates.title: diagnostics-schema
gates.notes: DEVIATION: :core:domain:testDebugUnitTest -> :core:domain:test (pure JVM module). Second segment is tools/acceptance/check-diagnostics.sh, owned by another engineer; when absent the harness reports BLOCKED for that segment.

gates.title: release-artifact
gates.notes: tools/acceptance/check-release-artifact.sh runs the R8/assemble gradle steps only under DSH_ALLOW_GRADLE=1, then drives apkanalyzer (manifest print + apk summary) and diffs exported components against acceptance/manifest-baseline.txt, enforces the TUNING.md size budgets (AAB <= 12 MiB, APK <= 20 MiB) and the canary-absent check. It prints BLOCKED (exit 3) when the release artifacts are not assembled yet.

gates.title: paging-and-large-data
gates.notes: No deviation: :core:data is an android.library module so testDebugUnitTest is correct. Per D31 the client does not use androidx.paging, so '*PagingSource*' resolves to RosterKeysetPagingSource (the keyset page source over SessionStore) and '*Retention*' to EventRetention; no PagingSource ever lives in :core:database.

gates.title: coverage-floor
gates.notes: Primary intent is ./gradlew koverVerify, but the Kover plugin is not applied in any build.gradle.kts and is unavailable on the mirror, so ACCEPTANCE's documented DEGRADED fallback is used as the registered command: check-golden-cases.sh case existence + per-gate JUnit floor in acceptance/coverage-floor.json. degradedAllowed=true; must carry a DECISIONS reference. References: D03 (mirror repo limits) + D21 (JVM-only test degrade path). Recovery condition: apply Kover and register ./gradlew koverVerify.

gates.title: i18n-parity
gates.notes: No deviation: pure source/resource scan.

gates.title: v0-v1-projection-parity
gates.notes: DEVIATION: the v0/v1 parity suite compares the two network projections (V0V1ProjectionParityTest), so the gate points at :core:network:testDebugUnitTest instead of :core:domain:test. The subject of the gate is unchanged; only the module that owns the real test moved.

gates.title: database-schema-migration
gates.notes: DEVIATION: ACCEPTANCE names ./gradlew :core:database:exportSchema, but exportSchema is a KSP/Room argument (room.schemaLocation), not a standalone Gradle task; running it as a task would be an unknown-task FAIL. The registered command is the JVM Retirement test (A->B->A idempotency + 7-day boundary) that lives in the same module; schema JSON is emitted by KSP during compilation and diffed via 'git diff --exit-code' in check-release/CI. Robolectric Room migration measurement is subject to D21 -> degradedAllowed=true; recovery condition is a working Robolectric to add real migration runs.

gates.title: dependency-fence
gates.notes: No deviation to the command. check-modules.sh implements the task-refined fence: feature/* gradle project deps restricted to :core:model/:core:domain/:core:designsystem; :app is the composition root and MAY declare impl project deps, so the :app fence is enforced at the import level (protocol/database/network imports only under app/**/di/** or DshApplication.kt/AppScope.kt). This differs from ACCEPTANCE's literal ':app 不出现 :core:protocol/network/database 的 project 依赖' wording, which the composition root necessarily violates; reconcile the doc.

gates.title: worker-handoff-semantics
gates.notes: No deviation: :core:data is android.library so testDebugUnitTest is correct. Subject is worker-handoff SEMANTICS (D10 CAS arbitration + SyncAttemptResult -> Success/Retry/Cancel). The WorkManager scheduler itself is not installed this round and the gate does not claim it: see D34, and the device checklist (G20) for real periodic runs.

gates.title: pairing-flow-invariants
gates.notes: No deviation: :core:data is android.library so testDebugUnitTest is correct.

gates.title: device-checklist-evidence
gates.notes: Builtin advisory gate. Verifies docs/DEVICE_CHECKLIST.md exists and every item carries a 状态 field; all items are NOT_RUN this round, so the gate is ADVISORY (never PASS). Instrumented/Compose-UI device automation is NOT_IN_SCOPE per DECISIONS D20 (no emulator, no system images, adb devices empty); this checklist is the human stand-in.
